args.text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Marrow Fieldworks you can find across Moss's notes and #central-random? List each with where it comes from. Need it before the customer call.

Here's what I found. None of these posts actually say "Marrow Fieldworks" next to the ticket number. They call it "the dealer account", so I've matched them up by context:

1. *#4409*: from Moss's "Central handoffs next week" digest (teams/team-central/digests, 2 Jan 2026). It's a recurring timeout on the Gatehouse Check-In report at the Salina North yard (Bay 4 and the west grain-bin apron, during the 06:00 flatbed intake).
2. *#4412*: same digest. It's a minor glitch in the driver SMS prompt when staging combine trailers on unpaved overflow lots.
   Moss lists both as tickets Hollis flagged on "Pree's dealer account" ahead of the Marrow Fieldworks handoff on Mon 5 Jan. That's why I'm reading them as Fieldworks tickets.
3. *#8841*: from your own message in #central-random (13 Oct, 09:27). West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk. Hollis called it your dealer account, so I'm assuming that's Fieldworks after the handoff.

Left out on purpose:
• FR-882 in the same Moss digest is a feature request from *Marrow Agrisupply* (custom pallet-jack icons). Different account.
• Moss's "Central cheat sheet" has no ticket numbers.
• There's nothing else in #central-random with a ticket number.

There are no other Moss notes or account files I can see, so I can't confirm whether #4409 and #4412 are still open. Worth checking the ticket system before your call.
